sections.Profile:
The Jump Shot pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1972, is an electro-mechanical (EM) game designed by Ed Krynski, with artwork by Gordon Morison. This one-player machine features a classic "add-a-ball" system.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1972
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Original Theme, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Gordon Morison
sections.Editions:
- All Stars: released 1972-01-01, model number 331
- Jump Shot: released 1972-01-01, model number 332
